title: Form fields inside a disabled fieldset must not be treated as tabbable, so a focus-trapped dialog focuses its first usable field
summary: Opening the delivery address dialog leaves keyboard focus behind on the page, because the trap tries to focus a select inside a disabled fieldset.
consumer: Author-written checkout page around the unchanged upstream ES module src/index.js at buggyCommit; the dialog uses the unchanged focus-trap v6.6.0 index.js (MIT, contemporaneous release depending on tabbable ^5.2.0) in upstream-dependency/, resolved with an import map.
